title: Pre-Analysis — Extension of the Requalified Oil Filter Housing to the CVX-7200 Fleet
abstract: Closed pre-analysis of a proposed revision extending the requalified oil filter housing, introduced after the casting source transfer, from the Auran installation to the CVX-7200 fleet under a second source arrangement.

sections.objective: Assess whether the requalified filter housing can be extended to the CVX-7200 installation under the second source arrangement now being negotiated, and identify what the extension would do to the retrofit bulletin, the removal and installation tasks and the pylon work already scheduled on those aircraft. The order was raised by the powerplant integration office ahead of the contract review, with a deliberately short scope: documentation and configuration only, no qualification content.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and none of them is a design obstacle, but the qualification question turned out to dominate the answer and sits outside this office. The installation task is written with one torque sequence and one heat shield fit for the Auran installation, and the CVX-7200 pylon presents the housing at a different angle; the task would need a second procedure rather than a note. The retrofit bulletin is effective on the Auran aircraft only and cannot be amended to cover a different engine type, so a second bulletin is needed. The third item is a prerequisite rather than a conflict: on the CVX-7200 aircraft the forward mount bushing standard changes the pylon access the housing work depends on, and the two have to be ordered.
sections.next_steps: The documentation position is settled and recorded here, but the extension cannot be recommended from this office. The qualification of the requalified casting on the CVX-7200 oil system, including the heat rejection case that the original qualification did not cover, was delegated to the powerplant integration office with the finding set attached. This work order was closed on that handover rather than left open, since nothing further can be decided until the qualification position is known.

similarity_seeds: filter housing casting source transfer and requalification
engine type effectivity on a powerplant retrofit

tasks.title: Search powerplant data on the housing across both engine types
Compare the pylon presentation and torque sequence
Establish the qualification gap for the CVX-7200 oil system

expected_findings.rationale: The installation task carries one torque sequence and one heat shield fit, both derived from the Auran pylon presentation. The CVX-7200 installation presents the housing at a different angle and the sequence does not transfer, so the task needs a second procedure rather than an effectivity note.
expected_findings.resolution: Plan a second installation procedure keyed on engine type if the extension proceeds; do not attempt to carry both in one sequence.

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin is effective on the Auran installation only and its material and manpower figures are quoted for that pylon. An engine type cannot be added to an effectivity block that was certified for one installation, so the extension needs a second bulletin rather than a revision.
expected_findings.resolution: Raise a separate bulletin for the CVX-7200 installation once the qualification is closed, and cross reference the two.

expected_findings.rationale: Retrieved on the pylon zones alone. On the CVX-7200 aircraft the forward mount bolt bushing standard changes the access sequence the housing work depends on, and the bushing installation tooling occupies the same envelope. The housing extension has to be ordered behind it on any aircraft not yet bushed.
expected_findings.resolution: Declare the bushing standard as an embodiment condition on the CVX-7200 effectivity of any future housing bulletin.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares the pylon zones with the subject and is retrieved by every search of this area, but it inspects the mount bolt bore. Nothing in it reads, removes or refits the filter housing, and the casting source has no bearing on a bore inspection.

type_data.conclusion: Issued 2026-07-09. Documentation position established; the qualification of the casting on the CVX-7200 oil system was delegated to the powerplant integration office and this order closed on the handover.
